title: VIP Homepage

fields.label: Sections
fields.name: sections
fields.instructions: Add and reorder homepage sections. Content appears on the site front page.

sub_fields.label: Background image
sub_fields.name: background_image
sub_fields.instructions: Full background when type is Image. When type is Video, used as poster/fallback.

sub_fields.label: Headline highlight
sub_fields.name: heading_highlight
sub_fields.instructions: Rendered larger on its own line (e.g. via WhatsApp).

sub_fields.label: Search form URL (optional)
sub_fields.name: search_action_url
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to use site search.

sub_fields.label: Filter slug
sub_fields.name: filter_slug
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Must match a Vehicles → Categories slug (sports, convertible, luxury, suv). Leave empty to derive from title.

sub_fields.label: Introduction
sub_fields.name: intro
sub_fields.default_value: Every occasion has its perfect car. We handle the sourcing, delivery, and logistics - you focus on the moment.

sub_fields.message: Choose which Occasion posts appear below. Card content (title, featured image, excerpt, button label) is loaded from each occasion. If these pickers are empty, all published occasions with Show on homepage enabled are used (menu order; one can be marked Featured on the occasion post).

sub_fields.label: Featured occasion (large left card)
sub_fields.name: featured_occasion
sub_fields.instructions: Pick one published Occasion for the large card on the left.

sub_fields.label: Grid occasions (up to 4)
sub_fields.name: grid_occasions
sub_fields.instructions: Pick up to four occasions for the 2×2 grid. Order here is the display order. The featured occasion above is excluded automatically if also selected here.

sub_fields.label: Introduction
sub_fields.name: intro
sub_fields.default_value: Everything you need to know about renting a luxury car in Dubai with VIP Transits.

sub_fields.label: Side image (car)
sub_fields.name: side_image
sub_fields.instructions: Cut-out vehicle image shown on the right (e.g. G-Class).

sub_fields.label: Section title
sub_fields.name: section_title
sub_fields.default_value: Our Luxury Car Fleet in Dubai

sub_fields.label: Subtitle
sub_fields.name: section_subtitle
sub_fields.default_value: Every brand. Every model. Available on demand.

sub_fields.label: Button label
sub_fields.name: button_label
sub_fields.instructions: Opens WhatsApp with this card's title and description (number is set under Settings → VIP Transits).

sub_fields.label: Introduction
sub_fields.name: intro
sub_fields.default_value: We deliver to every corner of Dubai - free, on time, and to your exact address.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.default_value: Message us anyway - we source any luxury car in Dubai on demand. If it exists in Dubai, we can get it.

sub_fields.label: WhatsApp button label
sub_fields.name: button_label
sub_fields.instructions: Opens WhatsApp with the heading and text above (number is set under Settings → VIP Transits).

description: Homepage flexible sections for VIP Transits (car rental).
